title: Kissed Crunchy Polish Ladyfingers Trifle
description: A citrusy and crunchy Polish dessert featuring savoiardi ladyfingers and confit tomato, made in a molcajete vessel. This dish is nut-free friendly and perfect for special occasions.
instructions: In a small saucepan, warm the orange marmalade over low heat.
Dip each ladyfinger into the warmed marmalade for about 3 seconds on each side.
In a large molcajete vessel, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Spread half of the confit tomato over the ladyfingers.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the granulated sugar and lemon zest to the whipped cream and mix until combined.
Spread the whipped cream mixture over the confit tomato layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the ladyfingers, then the remaining confit tomato, and finally another layer of whipped cream.
Dot the top of the whipped cream with unsalted butter.
Garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves.
